title: factdiff.py anchor --file --quotes anchors CODE-tagged facts, so a research item need not re-anchor a whole topic
goal: factdiff.py anchor --file F --quotes accepts a fact tagged CODE as a tagged fact, and anchoring one article's facts rewrites no _anchors.csv or _fetch_state.csv row of another topic
notes: SP-ofvvong6 retrospective: the ST-sxf575kx worker reported factdiff.py anchor --file ... --quotes refused its CODE facts as no tagged fact; it fell back to anchor --topic python/pytest-xdist, which also re-dated other topics rows in kb/public/_anchors.csv and _fetch_state.csv (a noisy diff it could not revert).
